name: Möira
summary: Möira is an action platformer that draws inspiration from the classic 8-bit portable games with a modern twist, memorable characters, lots of spells and awesome secrets! You play as Rubick, an young magician apprentice who’s searching for his missing master. In order to accomplish that, Rubick must travel through the Magic Kingdoms mimicking enemies’ powers and learning how to combine them using the staff his old master left to him. However, Rubick’s adventure won’t be easy since he’s going to fight against foes so powerful that are capable of distorting the limitations and break the rules of the land of Möira itself.

name: Möbler
summary:
Play as Birdo in this infinite platformer. Jump on the falling furniture to reach new heights, but don't get squashed or eaten by the monster!

Mobler is created by a student game development team consisting of 9 people.
We would love for you to help us by downloading, playing and leaving a review!
This will help us greatly.

name: Möbius Front '83
summary: Defend America from an alternate-universe America using state-of-the-art 1980s military hardware in this intricate and tactical turn-based strategy game.

name: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme
summary: Mörk Borg Heresy Supreme is a doom-metal action RPG set in the world of Mörk Borg. Wretched antiheroes explore a side-scrolling, semi-procedural grimdark fantasy world, searching for a way to prevent the apocalypse or make the suffering worse.

name: Möbius Trip
summary: The edges of your world loop. But the edges also aren't fixed in place. Manipulate the framing and the looping of the world to get to the exit tunnel.

name: Mörker
summary: An old-school dark fantasy action FPS. Fight cultists, undead, and other horrors in brutal combat where everything wants you dead.

name: Möbius Link 3D
summary: Möbius Link 3D is a turn-based space strategy game featuring 3D graphics. Players take on the role of Alice Schrödinger, commander of the Starfleet Möbius, an all-female fleet fighting its way through a series of missions against a rival imperial navy.

name: Möbius Link
summary: First entry in the Möbius Link series, it features a multi-scenario turn-based space fleet simulation game set amid a centuries-long war between two factions: the Empire and the Federation.
